los-frailes.wave_tips: Southeast swell with a west-northwest wind is the setup. Sharks and rocks are part of the read.
los-frailes.access_tips: Reached by the East Cape dirt road. Services are very limited.
los-frailes.best_conditions_prose: Best on a southeast swell with offshore wind.

frailes-south.seo_title: Frailes South Surf Report: East Cape Reef
frailes-south.seo_description: Frailes South surf forecast south of Los Frailes on Baja Sur's East Cape. Southeast swell, wind and reef notes.
frailes-south.description: Frailes South is the reef just south of Los Frailes on the East Cape. Like its neighbor, it needs a southeast swell to break.
frailes-south.wave_tips: Southeast swell with a west-northwest wind is the setup. Watch the reef edge.

el-pescadero.seo_title: El Pescadero Surf Report: Beach Break, Baja Sur
el-pescadero.seo_description: El Pescadero surf forecast between Todos Santos and Cerritos. A-frame beach peaks for winter and summer swell. Wind and tide.
el-pescadero.description: El Pescadero is the town between Todos Santos and Cerritos on the Pacific side of Baja California Sur. The beach in front produces A-frame peaks over sand and shallow reef, and it picks up both summer south swell and winter northwest swell. It can get crowded when it is good.
el-pescadero.wave_tips: West-southwest swell with a northeast wind is the setup; it works across the tide. Watch for rips and rocks.
el-pescadero.access_tips: Right off Highway 19. Camping and services are nearby.
el-pescadero.best_conditions_prose: Best on a west-southwest swell with a morning offshore.

boca-del-salado.seo_title: Boca del Salado Surf Report: Los Cabos East Side
boca-del-salado.seo_description: Boca del Salado surf forecast northeast of San José del Cabo. Beach and reef peaks for south swell. Wind, tide and hazards.
boca-del-salado.description: Boca del Salado is a mix of beach and reef peaks northeast of San José del Cabo. It is an easy trip from the Los Cabos airport area and works best on summer south swell. Urchins, rips and rocks are the main hazards.
boca-del-salado.wave_tips: South swell with a northwest wind is the setup.
boca-del-salado.access_tips: Reachable by car from San José del Cabo. Bring water and sun protection.
boca-del-salado.best_conditions_prose: Best on a solid summer south swell with offshore wind.

cerritos-point.seo_title: Cerritos Surf Report: Beginner-Friendly Beach, Baja
cerritos-point.seo_description: Cerritos surf forecast south of El Pescadero. A friendly beach break with a right off the point, lessons and board rentals.
cerritos-point.description: Cerritos is the most beginner-friendly beach on this stretch of coast, south of El Pescadero. A right wraps off the headland at the north end on northwest swell, and the beach takes south swell in summer. Board rentals, lessons and food are available on the beach, and the area is developing quickly.
cerritos-point.wave_tips: Northwest swell for the point and southwest swell for the beach. Mid tide usually gives the best shape. It gets busy on holidays.
cerritos-point.access_tips: Free parking at the beach, off Highway 19.
cerritos-point.best_conditions_prose: Best on a small to medium swell in the morning.

punta-gasparino.seo_title: Punta Gasparino Surf Report: Pacific Point, La Paz
punta-gasparino.seo_description: Punta Gasparino surf forecast on the Pacific side of La Paz municipality. Northwest swell, wind and tide notes.
punta-gasparino.description: Punta Gasparino is a point on the Pacific coast of La Paz municipality. It is easy to reach by Baja standards but does not break often, mainly on winter northwest swell.
punta-gasparino.wave_tips: Northwest swell with an east wind is the setup; it can work at all tides.
punta-gasparino.access_tips: Relatively easy access by Baja standards.
punta-gasparino.best_conditions_prose: Best on a winter northwest swell.

nine-palms.seo_title: Nine Palms Surf Report: East Cape Right Point
nine-palms.seo_description: Nine Palms surf forecast on Baja Sur's East Cape. A long right point that fires on summer south swell. Wind and tide notes.
nine-palms.description: Nine Palms is a long right-hand point on the East Cape road, north of San José del Cabo, named for the palm trees above the break. It needs a south or southeast swell and is one of the best waves on the East Cape when it is on, with a northwest wind blowing offshore.
nine-palms.wave_tips: South to southeast swell is the trigger, and a mid incoming tide is usually the best call.
nine-palms.access_tips: Park above the break on the East Cape road. There are no formal facilities.
nine-palms.best_conditions_prose: Best on a head-high to overhead summer south swell.

migrino.seo_title: Migriño Surf Report: Point and Beach Near Cabo
migrino.seo_description: Migriño surf forecast between Cerritos and Cabo San Lucas. A consistent point and beach on the Pacific side. Swell, wind and rips.
migrino.description: Migriño is a consistent point and beach between Cerritos and Cabo San Lucas, near a river mouth. It is a good alternative when Cerritos is crowded.
migrino.wave_tips: West-southwest swell with an east-northeast wind is the setup; tide is secondary.
migrino.access_tips: Dirt road off Highway 19. Services are in Cabo San Lucas or Cerritos.
migrino.best_conditions_prose: Best on a west-southwest swell with offshore wind.

shipwrecks-east-cape.seo_title: Shipwrecks Surf Report: East Cape, Los Cabos
shipwrecks-east-cape.seo_description: Shipwrecks surf forecast on the East Cape north of San José del Cabo. A fast right point for south swell. Wind and tide notes.
shipwrecks-east-cape.description: Shipwrecks is a fast right-hand point on the East Cape road north of San José del Cabo, named for the wreck near the break. It is one of the most consistent spots on the East Cape during south swell season, from spring through autumn. The rides are long, and so is the paddle back.
shipwrecks-east-cape.wave_tips: South swell with a northwest wind is the setup; tide is secondary.
shipwrecks-east-cape.access_tips: Park on the cliff and walk down. There are no facilities, so bring water.
shipwrecks-east-cape.best_conditions_prose: Best on a summer south swell.

san-jose-rivermouth.seo_title: San José Rivermouth Surf Report: Los Cabos
san-jose-rivermouth.seo_description: San José del Cabo rivermouth surf forecast by the estuary. A rare, powerful A-frame for south swell. Water quality notes.
san-jose-rivermouth.description: The San José rivermouth is at the estuary on the east end of San José del Cabo's beach. It only breaks well when storms open the sand berm, and then it can be a powerful A-frame. Water quality near the estuary can be poor.
san-jose-rivermouth.wave_tips: South swell with a north wind is the setup, with mid tide giving the best shape.
san-jose-rivermouth.access_tips: Park near La Playita or on the street by the estuary and walk over.
san-jose-rivermouth.best_conditions_prose: Best on a solid south swell after a storm has opened the river mouth.

acapulquito-costa-azul.seo_title: Acapulquito (Old Man's) Surf Report: Costa Azul
acapulquito-costa-azul.seo_description: Acapulquito surf forecast, the gentle right at Costa Azul in San José del Cabo. A beginner-friendly reef. Swell, wind and tide.
acapulquito-costa-azul.description: Acapulquito, also called Old Man's, is the gentle right in front of the Cabo Surf Hotel at Costa Azul. It is the most beginner-friendly wave in the San José del Cabo area, with soft walls that suit longboards and learners. Lessons and rentals are available nearby.
acapulquito-costa-azul.wave_tips: South to southwest swell with a north or northwest wind is the setup; it can be surfed from low through high tide.
acapulquito-costa-azul.access_tips: Access from the Tourist Corridor at Costa Azul, with parking nearby.
acapulquito-costa-azul.best_conditions_prose: Best on a small to medium south swell.

the-rock-la-roca-costa-azul.seo_title: La Roca Surf Report: The Rock at Costa Azul
the-rock-la-roca-costa-azul.seo_description: La Roca (The Rock) surf forecast at Costa Azul, near Zippers in San José del Cabo. A punchy, rocky right. Swell, wind and tide.
the-rock-la-roca-costa-azul.description: La Roca, or The Rock, is a punchy right along the beach from Zippers at Costa Azul. The lineup is full of boulders, so it is an expert wave. Mid to high tide is the safer window.
the-rock-la-roca-costa-azul.wave_tips: South and southwest swell is the setup; choose your takeoff carefully over the reef.
the-rock-la-roca-costa-azul.access_tips: Park at Zippers and walk along the beach. You can check the break from the cliff first.
the-rock-la-roca-costa-azul.best_conditions_prose: Best on a south swell at mid to high tide.

zippers-costa-azul.seo_title: Zippers Surf Report: Costa Azul, San José del Cabo
zippers-costa-azul.seo_description: Zippers surf forecast at Costa Azul, San José del Cabo. The best-known wave in Los Cabos, best on summer south swell.
zippers-costa-azul.description: Zippers is the best-known wave in Los Cabos, a fast right over cobblestone and reef at Costa Azul, just west of San José del Cabo. It comes alive on summer south swell and gets crowded when it does. Rocks, urchins and a strong current are all part of the session.
zippers-costa-azul.wave_tips: South to southwest swell with a northwest wind is the setup. It works at most tides, though low to mid often gives the best shape.
zippers-costa-azul.access_tips: Large parking lot at the break on the Tourist Corridor. San José del Cabo has everything else.
zippers-costa-azul.best_conditions_prose: Best on a head-high to overhead summer south swell.

la-punta.seo_title: La Punta Surf Report: Cabo San Lucas Reef
la-punta.seo_description: La Punta surf forecast in the Cabo San Lucas area. A reef for summer south swell. Wind, tide and crowd notes.
la-punta.description: La Punta is a reef in the Cabo San Lucas area that works on south swell and can get crowded when it breaks.
la-punta.wave_tips: South swell with a north-northwest wind is the setup.
la-punta.access_tips: Reached from the Cabo San Lucas area.
la-punta.best_conditions_prose: Best on a summer south swell.

rancho-san-carlos.seo_title: Rancho San Carlos Surf Report: Cabo Reef
rancho-san-carlos.seo_description: Rancho San Carlos surf forecast in the Cabo San Lucas reef zone. South-southeast swell, wind and tide notes.
rancho-san-carlos.description: Rancho San Carlos is a reef in the Cabo San Lucas area that picks up south-southeast swell in summer.
rancho-san-carlos.wave_tips: South-southeast swell with a northwest wind is the setup. The reef cover matters more than the tide.
rancho-san-carlos.access_tips: Reached from the Cabo San Lucas area.
rancho-san-carlos.best_conditions_prose: Best on a summer south swell.

punta-palmilla.seo_title: Punta Palmilla Surf Report: Los Cabos Right Point
punta-palmilla.seo_description: Punta Palmilla surf forecast on the Tourist Corridor near San José del Cabo. A consistent right point for south swell.
punta-palmilla.description: Punta Palmilla is the right-hand point near the Palmilla resort on the Tourist Corridor, west of San José del Cabo. It is one of the more consistent spots in the area during south swell season.
punta-palmilla.wave_tips: South swell with a northwest wind is the setup; check the reef cover and how the shoulder is breaking.
punta-palmilla.access_tips: Access is from the Tourist Corridor. Use public beach access points.
punta-palmilla.best_conditions_prose: Best on a summer south swell.

monuments.seo_title: Monuments Surf Report: Cabo San Lucas Left
monuments.seo_description: Monuments surf forecast in Cabo San Lucas. A steep left that picks up west and southwest swell. Wind, tide and access.
monuments.description: Monuments is the steep left at the east end of Cabo San Lucas bay, where deep water near the headland focuses west and southwest swell. It is one of the few spots near Cabo that picks up winter swell, and it is close to town. The takeoff zone is tight, and afternoon wind often ruins it.
monuments.wave_tips: West and southwest swells are the main triggers, with a north or northeast wind. Go early.
monuments.access_tips: Access runs through a gated resort area on the Tourist Corridor; surfers are usually let in. Park above and take the trail down.
monuments.best_conditions_prose: Best on a west or southwest swell in the early morning.

bahia-chileno.seo_title: Bahía Chileno Surf Report: Tourist Corridor Bay
bahia-chileno.seo_description: Bahía Chileno surf forecast on the Los Cabos Tourist Corridor. A snorkeling bay that occasionally breaks on south swell.
bahia-chileno.description: Bahía Chileno is a sheltered bay on the Tourist Corridor, better known for swimming and snorkeling. The reef only breaks on a strong south-southeast swell, and it is inconsistent.
bahia-chileno.wave_tips: South-southeast swell with a northwest wind is the setup.
bahia-chileno.access_tips: Signed public access from the Tourist Corridor with parking close to the beach.
bahia-chileno.best_conditions_prose: Worth a look only on a strong south swell.

backwash.seo_title: Backwash Surf Report: Cabo San Lucas Beach
backwash.seo_description: Backwash surf forecast in the Cabo San Lucas area. A beach that needs a solid southeast to south swell. Wind and tide.
backwash.description: Backwash is a beach in the Cabo San Lucas area that needs a solid southeast to south swell to break, so it is inconsistent.
backwash.wave_tips: South-southeast swell with a northwest wind is the setup. Skip it if the waves look soft.
backwash.access_tips: Reached from the Cabo San Lucas area.
backwash.best_conditions_prose: Best on a solid summer south swell.

teresas.seo_title: Teresa's Surf Report: Rosarito Break Forecast
teresas.seo_description: Teresa's surf forecast in Rosarito, Baja California, near K-38 and Popotla. Live swell, wind and tide, plus notes on the tide window.
teresas.description: Teresa's is a lesser-known break in the Rosarito area, on the same stretch of coast as K-38 and Popotla. It gets overlooked because of its better-known neighbors, but it can be a good wave on the right tide. It suits experienced surfers.
teresas.wave_tips: It tends to be punchier on a lower tide. Onshore wind hurts the shape quickly, so aim for an early session.
teresas.access_tips: Access is informal and can change. Rosarito has food and supplies.
teresas.best_conditions_prose: Best on a clean swell at lower tide with a calm or offshore morning.
